problems: The test profile sets both --transcript_fasta and --additional_fasta. validateInputParameters() raises transcriptFastaAdditionalFastaError() when both are given and the selected pseudo-aligner has no pre-built index. The baseline only passes this check because --salmon_index is supplied. With --pseudo_aligner kallisto and no --kallisto_index, needs_to_build_index becomes true and the pipeline errors out during PIPELINE_INITIALISATION, before any process runs. To make the change work, supply a --kallisto_index that already contains the GFP spike-in, or drop --transcript_fasta (or --additional_fasta).
rationale: Switching pseudo_aligner to kallisto would build a Kallisto index from the transcript FASTA, run KALLISTO_QUANT instead of SALMON_QUANT, and re-run the downstream tximport, SummarizedExperiment, DESeq2 pseudo QC and MultiQC steps with kallisto inputs and prefixes. The STAR/Salmon alignment path and Salmon-based strandedness inference would be unchanged, since UNTAR_SALMON_INDEX still runs because salmon_index is set. In the test profile, however, the run would fail at parameter validation, so the lists above describe what would change only if the conflict is resolved.
